pages.text: This block is the core's input and output port; the controller cannot connect to an energy network directly.$(br2)Place a full glass block directly against it on the side facing an active core. The glass becomes a spherical terminal when valid. Connect cables or crystals to this block, not the controller. Use the sphere to switch input/output; sneak-use the block to select another nearby active core.

pages.name: Input/Output Port
pages.text: The structure uses one pylon and one full glass block. The glass side must face the active Energy Core: $(bold)Pylon → Glass → Core$(). Cables and crystals connect to the pylon block itself.
